overview: 针对具有稀疏成功信号的机器人任务，作者提出了一种名为STL-SVPG的方法。该方法通过将信号时序逻辑（STL）的鲁棒性作为轨迹级训练目标，利用Stein变分策略梯度对策略进行优化。通过跨动力学微分，该方法能够根据动作对完整任务规范的影响进行归因，而非仅依赖局部进展。实验在六项四轴飞行器及机械臂任务中评估了该方法，结果显示其在五项基准测试中达到了最高的平均成功率，并实现了仿真到现实的迁移。

highlights.text: STL-SVPG利用平滑的STL鲁棒性作为轨迹级目标，通过对动力学微分实现任务级别的动作归因。
highlights.evidence: We present Signal Temporal Logic-guided Stein Variational Policy Gradient (STL-SVPG), a population-based method that uses smooth STL robustness as a trajectory-level training objective. Differentiating this objective through the dynamics assigns credit to policy actions according to their effect on the complete task specification, rather than local progress alone.

highlights.text: 该方法在六个包含复杂交互、严格顺序及时间限制的机器人任务中表现优异。
highlights.evidence: We evaluate the approach on six quadcopter and manipulator tasks that involves event-triggered responses, strictly ordered behavior, responses within specified deadlines, and physical interaction with the world. STL-SVPG achieves the highest mean success rate among the compared methods on five of six benchmarks.
